strengths: Clean technical SEO baseline: robots.txt with Sitemap line, sitemap index with 32 product + 42 collection URLs, canonicals and unique titles/meta descriptions on 20/20 sampled PDPs, Product+Offer+FAQPage JSON-LD on every PDP (captures/fh_pdp_sample_summary.json).

Native Shopify Search & Discovery metafield filters (Gender, Life Stage, Health Benefit, Key Ingredients, Made Without, Product Form, Lifestyle, FSA/HSA) plus 9 sort options on collections and a working search results page (captures/fh_collections_female-fertility-supplements.html).

Consistent PDP template on 20/20 sampled products: Key benefits / Ingredients / Suggested Use / Product Description / FAQ / Frequently Bought Together, Stamped review counts (up to 1,921), Recharge 10% subscribe widget, and prices that match products.json and collection cards on 20/20 (captures/fh_pdp_sample_summary.json).

Promotions: the '30% OFF LIMITED-TIME OFFER - SELECT SIZES - APPLIED IN CART' badge sits on 5 single-variant products (FertileCM, FertiliTea, Milkies, Complete Lactation Support, Menopause Multivitamin Essentials) while PDP/card/JSON-LD still show full price and compare_at_price is null on 32/32 products - use compare-at pricing or a Shopify Function discount that renders the sale price on card and PDP, and fix the 'select sizes' copy.

Catalog data: fill product_type on 32/32 products (blank today vs 0/112 blank on bariatricfusion.com), normalize the 32 tags (three spellings of 'vaginal care', internal tags like exclude_rebuy/fam-fhpro-men mixed with merchandising tags), and move Supplement Facts from image-only (*_SFP.jpg on 17/20 PDPs) into a metafield rendered as an HTML table.
notes: All 40 Fairhaven fetches returned 200 via curl (no JS-render fallback needed). Review widgets (Stamped) and the Recharge subscription widget render client-side; counts were read from server-side badge attributes (data-reviews/data-rating) and SubscriptionWidgetConfig. Checkout was not entered; B3 is based on accelerated-checkout buttons on the PDP. Blog article pages were not fetched (per-store fetch cap), so N1 reflects the undated index only. Sister stores bariatricfusion.com, vitalnutrients.co and unjury.com were sampled (17 fetches total) for Part 2 cross-brand findings only and are not scored here. Health/medical claim language was deliberately not evaluated.
